title: 第26章 三道黑光第27章 黑甲虫
content_zh:
第26章三道黑光
分完了瓶子，大家又转身来到了大殿中央那个丹炉边，青阳站在两丈多高的丹炉边上，仰望着丹炉的顶部，一股崇拜之情油然而生。这么大的丹炉，只有仙师才能造出来，也只有仙师才能用得上，自己这些凡夫俗子，恐怕这辈子也就只能仰望了。
这么大的丹炉，他们这些人普通人是没能力打开的，虎镇嵩只好拿着那鉴灵盘，围着丹炉转了一圈，发现鉴灵盘一点反应也没有才作罢。想不到这么大一座丹炉，竟然只是一件凡物！
看了两处，都没找到有用的东西，难道这么雄壮的一座大殿，连件宝物都没有？真是亏大发了，费了这么大的功夫，结果这大殿里的收获还不如外面那两尊石像。
大家都有点不甘心，又朝着右边的那堆垃圾走去，不过他们并不抱什么希望，那巨大的丹炉和数十个丹药瓶之中都没找到有用的东西，这垃圾堆里又能寻到什么宝物？
但世事就是那么难料，虎镇嵩刚把鉴灵盘靠近垃圾堆，上面就有几道红光闪烁起来，这红光比门外得到的那两枚青色晶石还亮，难道垃圾堆里有什么了不得的宝物？
虎镇嵩顿时喜出望外，把鉴灵盘往怀中一放，就扒开了前面的垃圾堆。其他人的喜悦一点也不比虎镇嵩少，若是能找到令仙师满意的好东西，仙师肯定不会少了他们的奖赏，于是大家一起动手，在前面的垃圾堆上翻找起来。
忽然，垃圾堆里射出三道黑光，速度之快，令人咋舌。
其中一道黑光射向的是松鹤老道，松鹤老道混迹江湖了半辈子，虽然最近没有遇到什么危险，但警惕心始终是有的，那黑光虽快，松鹤老道的速度也不慢，随手甩出一把拂尘，就卷在了那黑光上。
但那黑光的力道实在是大，竟然带着整个拂尘朝松鹤老道飞去，松鹤老道的拂尘差点就脱了手。也是他江湖经验足够丰富，连忙运功入手，使出四两拨千斤的功夫用力一甩，才把那道黑光给甩到了另外一边。
那黑光却并没有被甩远，在空中一个盘旋，转身之后竟然朝着另一侧的空寂大师飞去。空寂大师的实力一点也不弱于松鹤老道，只见他手一伸，取出一个手掌大的紫金钵盂就朝那黑光罩了过去。
那黑光一时不查，就被紫金钵盂罩了个正着，那黑光似乎根本就不在乎，竟然顶着钵盂往前飞。空寂大师也没有料到黑光的力道竟然这么大，一时不查差点就被顶了个仰面朝天。
好在他及时加大了功力，把紫金钵盂又给顶了回去，然后顺势把钵盂倒扣过来，用强力压到了地上。那黑光似乎很不甘心，在钵盂之中左冲右突，撞得紫金钵盂当当直响，震得空寂大师手都麻了。
空寂大师不知道那黑光是什么，但是他能够感觉到黑光对自己的威胁，他神秘都不敢打开紫金钵盂，生怕把那黑光放出来之后，用同样的手段再也无法制住。于是他一手按着紫金钵盂，另一只手运起开碑裂石的开山掌，就拍在了紫金钵盂上。
一掌下去，紫金钵盂顿时就瘪了，但是里面的黑光却并没有消停，空寂大师想都没想，又是一掌拍了下去。紫金钵盂更扁了，里面的黑光似乎也感到了生命威胁，冲撞的也更激烈了，空寂大师一只手已经有点按不住，只好双手一起按在了钵盂的边上。
两只手按着紫金钵盂，空寂大师精力都用在了这上面，就无法对付钵盂下的黑光了。这是松鹤老道走了过来，一脚就踩在了钵盂上，那钵盂彻底塌了下去，里面的黑光也没了动静。
松鹤老道生怕他不死，又用力踩了好几脚，直到把钵盂彻底踩成了一块铁板，这才罢休。两个江湖中的一流高手相互配合，费了老大的功夫，才弄死了一道黑光。
另外一道黑光射向的是虎镇嵩。
虎家五兄弟都是一流高手，其中又以虎镇嵩为最，比松鹤老道和空寂大师也不差毫分，眼见黑光冲着自己心口而来，他不敢用手硬接，只好来了一个铁板桥，身体硬生生的弯了下去，躲过了致命一击。
那黑光扑空之后并没有落地，而是转了一个圈，又朝着虎镇嵩飞去。虎家五兄弟心意相通，相互之间配合默契，早在大哥遇险的时候，其他三位兄弟已经围了上来，做好了应对的准备。

只见虎镇华手一甩，一把飞刀正射向那黑光，飞刀与黑光相撞，黑光只是稍微顿了一下，那飞刀却直接被撞了回来。连飞刀都伤不到那黑光，可见那黑光有多么恐怖。
不过黑光被飞刀这么一阻，速度也慢了下来，这时虎镇泰也已经攻了上来，他双手握着一把宝刀，朝着那黑光就劈了下去。
若是没有前面那一把飞刀，或许黑光就躲过去了，就是以为那飞刀的干扰，黑光就被宝刀劈了个正着。只听当的一声脆响，那黑光跌落到了地上，宝刀也被撞出了一个豁口。
那黑光却还没有死，在地上挣扎了几下，眼看就要飞起来，最后一个虎镇恒也到了，一把镔铁锤转眼之间砸在了那黑光之上，那黑光顿时就被砸成了一团碎渣，已经是死的不能再死了。
而最后一道黑光射向的却是皮应熊。
皮应熊身材高大肌肉发达，本就不是以速度见长，他的功力又比松鹤老道等人低不少，在江湖上也只能算是二流高手，面对这突然出现的黑光，就有点手足无措了，等他反应过来的时候已经来不及了，那黑光转眼之间就没入了他的胸口。
胸口里面就是心脏，若是心脏出了问题，这人还能活吗？杜成金和钱半仙就站在皮应熊的旁边，却无力施救，一是他们速度跟不上，而是没有对付那黑光的好办法，难道皮应熊会就此死去不成？
就在这时，只听吱的一声尖叫，一只狸猫从皮应熊的胸口窜了出来，没跑几步就倒在地上，然后抽搐了几下就死了。
（本章完）
content_en:
Chapter 26 Three Black Lights
After dividing the bottles, everyone turned around and came to the alchemy stove in the center of the hall. Qingyang stood beside the two-foot-high alchemy stove, looking up at the top of the alchemy stove, a feeling of admiration welling up spontaneously. Only immortal masters can build such a large alchemy furnace, and only immortal masters can use it. Ordinary people like me may only be able to look up to it in this life.
Ordinary people like them couldn't open such a large alchemy furnace. Hu Zhensong had no choice but to take the spirit appraiser plate and circle around the alchemy furnace. He gave up when he found that the spirit appraiser plate had no reaction at all. I never thought that such a big alchemy furnace could be just a mortal object!
After looking in two places, I couldn't find anything useful. Could it be that such a majestic palace doesn't even have a single treasure? What a big loss. After spending so much effort, the harvest in this hall is not as good as the two stone statues outside.
Everyone was a little reluctant and walked towards the pile of garbage on the right, but they did not hold out much hope. Nothing useful was found in the huge alchemy furnace and dozens of pill bottles. What treasures could be found in this garbage pile?
But things are so unpredictable. As soon as Hu Zhensong put the spirit plate close to the garbage heap, several red lights flashed on it. The red light was brighter than the two cyan crystals obtained outside the door. Could there be any great treasure in the garbage heap?
Hu Zhensong was immediately overjoyed. He put the spirit plate in his arms and opened up the garbage pile in front of him. The joy of the others was no less than that of Hu Zhensong. If they could find good things that satisfied the Immortal Master, the Immortal Master would definitely not miss their rewards, so everyone started to rummage through the garbage pile in front.
Suddenly, three black lights shot out from the garbage heap, the speed was staggering.
One of the black lights shot towards Songhe Laodao. Songhe Laodao had been wandering around the world for half his life. Although he had not encountered any danger recently, he was always vigilant. Although the black light was fast, Songhe Laodao was not slow at all. He threw out a whisk and got caught in the black light.
But the power of the black light was so great that it actually took the entire whisk and flew towards Songhe Laodao. Songhe Laodao almost lost his grip on the whisk. It was because he had enough experience in the martial arts that he quickly used his kung fu to throw the black light to the other side with four or two thousand kilograms of effort.
The black light was not thrown away, it hovered in the air, turned around, and flew towards Master Kongji on the other side. Master Kongji's strength was not weaker than that of Songhe Laodao. He stretched out his hand, took out a palm-sized purple gold alms bowl and threw it towards the black light.
The black light didn't check for a moment, but it was covered by the purple gold alms bowl. The black light didn't seem to care at all, and actually flew forward with the alms bowl on its head. Master Kongji didn't expect the black light to be so powerful, and he was almost knocked upside down if he didn't check it for a moment.
Fortunately, he increased his skill in time and pushed the purple gold bowl back, then turned the bowl upside down and pressed it to the ground with force. The black light seemed to be unwilling to do so, rushing left and right in the alms bowl, causing the purple gold alms bowl to clang, and making Master Kongji's hands go numb.
Master Kongji didn't know what the black light was, but he could feel the threat of the black light to himself. He was so mysterious that he didn't dare to open the purple gold alms bowl, for fear that after releasing the black light, he would never be able to control it again with the same means. So he pressed the purple gold alms bowl with one hand, and with the other hand, he lifted the mountain-opening palm used to crack the monument and cracked the stone, and slapped it on the purple gold alms bowl.
With one palm strike, the purple gold alms bowl deflated immediately, but the black light inside did not stop. Master Kongji struck it down with another palm without even thinking. The purple-gold alms bowl became even flatter, and the black light inside seemed to feel life-threatening, and the collision became more intense. Master Kongji could no longer hold it down with one hand, so he had to press both hands on the edge of the alms bowl.
Two hands pressing the purple gold alms bowl, Master Kongji spent all his energy on this, and was unable to deal with the black light under the alms bowl. This is when Old Taoist Songhe came over and stepped on the alms bowl. The alms bowl collapsed completely, and the black light inside stopped moving.
Old Taoist Songhe was afraid that he would not die, so he stepped on him several times until the alms bowl was completely turned into an iron plate, and then he stopped. The two top masters in the world cooperated with each other, and it took a lot of effort from the boss to kill a black light.
Another black light shot towards Hu Zhensong.
The five brothers of the Hu family are all top-notch masters, and Hu Zhensong is the best among them. He is no worse than Master Songhe and Master Kongji. Seeing the black light coming towards his heart, he did not dare to block it with his hands, so he had to use an iron bridge to bend his body and avoid the fatal blow.
The black light did not land after it flew into the air, but turned in a circle and flew towards Hu Zhensong again. The five brothers of the Hu family are connected and cooperate with each other tacitly. When the eldest brother was in danger, the other three brothers had already surrounded him and were ready to deal with it.
Hu Zhenhua flicked his hand, and a flying knife was shot at the black light. The flying knife collided with the black light. The black light only paused for a moment, but the flying knife was directly knocked back. Even flying knives can't hurt the black light, which shows how terrifying the black light is.
However, the black light was blocked by the flying knife and slowed down. At this time, Hu Zhentai had also attacked. He held a sword in both hands and struck at the black light.
If there hadn't been the flying knife in front of him, perhaps Black Light would have dodged away, thinking that the flying knife was interfering, and Black Light would have been hit squarely by the sword. There was only a crisp sound, the black light fell to the ground, and the sword was also knocked out of a gap.
The black light was not dead yet. It struggled on the ground for a few times and was about to fly. The last Hu Zhenheng also arrived. A hammer hit the black light in the blink of an eye. The black light was immediately smashed into a ball of debris. It was already dead and could no longer die.
But the last black light shot towards Pi Yingxiong.
Pi Yingxiong was tall and muscular, and he was not known for his speed. His skill was much lower than that of Songhe Laodao and others, and he could only be regarded as a second-rate master in the arena. Faced with the sudden appearance of the black light, he was a little at a loss. By the time he reacted, it was already too late, and the black light disappeared into his chest in the blink of an eye.
Inside the chest is the heart. If there is a problem with the heart, can this person still live? Du Chengjin and Qian Banxian were standing next to Pi Yingxiong, but they were unable to save him. First, they couldn't keep up with their speed, and they didn't have a good way to deal with the black light. Could it be that Pi Yingxiong would die just like that?
At this moment, a scream was heard, and a civet cat jumped out of Piyingxiong's chest. He fell to the ground after running a few steps, twitched a few times and died.
(End of chapter)
